projects.title: My projects
projects.emptyHint: Create your first project to get started.

project.articlesHint: See what the models decided, review the uncertain cases.
project.promptsHint: Advanced: the prompt is generated from your question; edit it here if needed.
project.benchmarksHint: Compare several models on that sample: accuracy, recall, F1, time.
project.inferenceHint: Ask your question, choose the models (cascade possible) and run the triage on all articles.
project.deleteConfirm: Delete this project and all its content?
project.noModels: No triage model registered: benchmark and inference are not possible.
project.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to add one.
project.howBody: 1) Import articles from PubMed (corpus frozen). 2) On “Analyse”: write your question, choose the models (an optional fast triage, then an in-depth analysis) and run on the whole corpus. 3) Check the results: confident cases are accepted or dropped automatically, review only the uncertain ones. Gold and benchmark are optional.
project.question: Question
project.questionHint: Define the question asked to articles and the answer fields.
project.needsCorpus: Available once the corpus is imported and frozen.
project.optionalHint: Not needed for triage. Useful to check a model's quality or compare several: annotate a reference sample (gold), then run a benchmark.
project.importBannerHint: You can leave this page: the import keeps running in the background.
project.analysisBannerStart: Analysis in progress: starting the models…
project.teamHint: Invite collaborators and manage their access.
project.stopTitle: Stop the analysis (articles already analysed are kept)
project.emptyCorpus: No articles yet: import a corpus to get started.
project.analysedPctHelp: Share of this search's lot already analysed by a model
project.reviewedPctHelp: Share of the lot reviewed by at least one person

import.title: PubMed import
import.intro: Search PubMed, check the article count, then start the import: metadata and full text (PMC Open Access) are fetched. The corpus is frozen at the end.
import.checkFirst: Check the volume first to enable import.
import.capNote: only the first 10,000 will be imported
import.confirmBig: {n} articles: the import may take a long time (≈ 1 s per article with full text). Continue?
import.truncated: Result truncated to 10,000 articles: refine the query.
import.fulltextHint: Articles without PMC Open Access full text are analysed on the abstract only.
import.lockedProcessing: An import is running: wait for it to finish.
import.lockedFrozen: The corpus is frozen: an import already took place. Create a new project for another query.
import.sectionsHint: Choose which parts of the article are given to the models. Can be changed at any time (no re-import).
import.backgroundNote: The import runs in the background: you can leave the page, even for thousands of articles. Progress stays visible at the top of every project page.
import.fulltextCount: {n} of {total} article(s) have full text. The others only have the abstract.
import.fulltextExplain: PubMed/PMC does not cover everything. The button looks for legal, free copies: Europe PMC, Unpaywall, OpenAlex (accepted manuscripts, institutional repositories, bioRxiv/medRxiv/arXiv preprints). A truly paywalled article with no open copy stays abstract-only. Also run automatically after each import; background task, you can leave the page.
import.fulltextDone: {found} full text(s) added out of {total} searched.
import.addHint: The corpus already holds {n} article(s). A new (or broadened) query completes it: articles already present are skipped, only new ones are added. Past analyses are kept; re-run “Analyse” to process the new ones.
import.retryHint: Same query: articles already imported are skipped, only missing ones are added.

articles.title: Results and review
articles.emptyHint: Import articles from PubMed to see them here.
articles.notTriaged: Triage has not been run yet.
articles.exportZipHelp: Articles, full texts, PDFs, results, queries and models in one zip. Prepared in the background.
articles.exportRefsHelp: Standard format: direct import into Zotero, EndNote, Mendeley, Citavi…
articles.exportRefsFiltered: Exported references follow the list filters.
articles.exportZipMail: You can leave the page: an e-mail will tell you when it is ready (if mail is configured).
articles.exportZipReady: Download the zip ({mb} MB, {articles} articles, {pdf} PDFs) — valid 7 days
articles.exportZipFailed: The export failed: please try again.
articles.relevanceHelp: Probability that the article answers the project question (drives automatic triage).
articles.certaintyHelp: The model's certainty for this specific answer.
articles.bulkHint: Each PDF is attached to the article whose title (or DOI) it carries. Project leads only.
articles.bulkNoMatch: no article in this project matches
articles.bulkAmbiguous: several possible articles: upload it from the article page
articles.searchPlaceholder: Find an article: title, author, journal, PMID, DOI…

gold.title: Gold standard
gold.intro: References are the human reviews you keep as the truth. They apply to every search that asks the same question.
gold.addAll: Add all reviews to the gold
gold.emptyHint: Review some articles, then add them to the gold from the review page or with the button above.
gold.fewWarning: Only {n} reference(s): aim for at least {min} to get reliable measures.
gold.removeConfirm: Remove this article from the gold?

benchmarks.title: Benchmarks
benchmarks.emptyHint: Run a benchmark to evaluate a prompt.
benchmarks.intro: Compare prompts (or models) on the same set of articles to find the best questions and the best output.
benchmarks.oneAtATime: A benchmark is already running: only one at a time per project.
benchmarks.concept: Same models, same articles, different prompts: the benchmark ranks the wordings. The gold standard is only an optional reference to score the variants, or examples to teach the model.
benchmarks.benchHint: The article set of a search. Ideally a small tuning subset (random draw or filter).
benchmarks.notTuning: This is not a tuning subset: consider creating one to limit computation time.
benchmarks.lotWarn: Set of {n} articles: the benchmark will be slow (CPU computation). Reduce the set if possible.
benchmarks.tuningHint: A random draw of N articles (30 by default) or a filter. It becomes a "tuning" search.
benchmarks.scorerHint: Decision models ignore prompt variants: they count as a single answer.
benchmarks.variantsHint: Each variant is a system prompt you write freely. With no variant, a single prompt generated from the search question is used.
benchmarks.variantsNone: No variant: the prompt generated from the question will be used.
benchmarks.variantPromptPlaceholder: You are an assistant that screens scientific articles…
benchmarks.variantErr_prompt: A variant's system prompt cannot be empty.
benchmarks.goldHint: The gold standard is not the benchmark: it is a reference to score the variants, and/or examples added to the prompt.
benchmarks.useGold: Validate with the gold standard (score the variants on lot articles that have a reference)
benchmarks.useExamples: Use N gold examples in the prompt
benchmarks.examplesHint: These examples are excluded from scoring. They are taken outside the lot when possible.
benchmarks.goldNone: No gold references for this search: these options are unavailable. Add references on the Gold page.
benchmarks.goldCount: {n} gold reference(s) (only those in the lot are used for scoring).
benchmarks.err_tooMany: Too many calls ({n} > {max}): reduce the set, the models or the variants.
benchmarks.err_noGold: No gold references in this lot: untick "validate with gold" or change the lot.
benchmarks.err_inProgress: A benchmark is already running for this project.
benchmarks.noResults: No results recorded for this benchmark.
benchmarks.rankedOnAgreement: No gold: ranked on agreement between variants, then time.
benchmarks.rankedOnTime: No gold and no variants to compare: ranked on time.
benchmarks.useForAnalysisHint: "Use for analysis" opens the analysis page with this model; a free-form variant is saved as a project prompt and selected.
benchmarks.noGoldScores: No scores: the benchmark was not validated with the gold standard. The ranking above relies only on agreement between variants and time.
benchmarks.disagreeHint: Articles where variants (or models) differ come first. In red: differs from the gold reference.

inference.title: Analyse the corpus
inference.emptyHint: Run inference on the project's articles.
inference.prefilterHint: Fast encoder (e.g. Laya): drops off-topic articles on title + abstract before the main model.
inference.prefilteredCount: {n} article(s) dropped by the pre-filter, no main-model call.
inference.intro: Write what you are looking for, choose the models and run: every article is read and triaged. Confident cases are triaged automatically; uncertain ones are offered for review.
inference.stage1Hint: Fast encoder: drops off-topic articles on title + abstract.
inference.stage2Hint: Answers the question and quotes passages.
inference.routingHint: Final routing by confidence: > 85% accepted, < 15% dropped, in between to review.
inference.stage1Why: Reads only title + abstract and drops off-topic articles right away, sparing stage 2.
inference.stage1Which: Fits: a light decision model (e.g. Laya) or a cheap external model.
inference.stage2Why: Reads the chosen text (methods, results…) for the articles stage 1 kept.
inference.stage2Which: Fits: a bigger decision model (Kev) or a generative/external model (quotes passages and explains).
inference.firstRunNote: The very first run downloads the models: it may take several minutes before the counter moves.
inference.resumeHint: {n} articles already analysed are kept; only the others will be processed.
inference.stopHint: The article being processed finishes, then the analysis stops. Articles already analysed are kept.
inference.stopped: Analysis stopped manually: {n} article(s) analysed and kept. You can resume it.
inference.searchHint: The analysis covers this search's batch; its results belong to it.
inference.goldHint: Use the gold references to guide the model and/or measure its results.
inference.goldNone: No gold references for this search: options unavailable. Add references on the Gold page.
inference.useExamples: Use N gold examples in the prompt
inference.examplesHint: These examples are added to the prompt and excluded from validation.
inference.validateGold: Validate the results with the gold standard
inference.validateHint: When the analysis is done, answers are compared with the gold references present in the lot.
inference.goldExamplesUsed: {n} gold example(s) used in the prompt.
inference.scopeNewHint: Pick the articles by criteria (answers of a previous analysis, reviewed, full text, random draw…). A search is created with the question below, then analysed: it stays available under “All searches”.
inference.scopeCount: {n, plural, one {# article will be analysed} other {# articles will be analysed}}

settings.title: System settings
settings.llmHelp: Address of the Ollama server running generative models (Qwen, Gemma…). In Docker it is already set: you normally change nothing. Not needed for Laya and Kev.
settings.llmApiKeyHint: Only if the server is protected by a token.
settings.smtpHelp: Used to send invitations and end-of-processing e-mails.
settings.ncbiHelp: Without a key: 3 requests/s to PubMed; with a free key: 10/s.
settings.contactHelp: E-mail sent to Unpaywall and OpenAlex (courtesy, required by these free services) to find full texts. If empty, the SMTP sender e-mail is used.

annotate.title: Annotation
annotate.confidenceInvalid: The confidence score must be between 0 and 1.
annotate.noEvidence: This decision model gives a score only, no excerpt or reasoning. For highlighted passages and an explanation, use a generative or external model at stage 2.
annotate.abstractOnlyNote: Abstract only: no open-access full text was found. If you can access the article (your institution's subscription), upload its PDF.
annotate.reviewEditHint: You can correct or complete, then save: the review is updated under your name.
annotate.pdfMismatch: This PDF does not look like this article (its title is not at the top of the document). Use it anyway?
annotate.searchFulltext: Search for the full text again
annotate.preprintNote: Preprint: the license chosen by the authors does not permit archiving in PMC. The full text is on the preprint server (see the “Open full text / PDF” link above): search again, or add the PDF yourself.
annotate.blindHidden: The model's answer and the highlighted evidence stay hidden until your review is saved.
annotate.blindRevealed: Your review is saved: the model's answer is now shown.
annotate.goldUpdated: ✓ Gold standard updated with this review.
annotate.goldSkipped: This article cannot be added (no review).

models.title: Triage models
models.intro: Installed models can be used to triage your corpora. Add more at the bottom of the page.
models.name: Name
models.emptyHint: Search a model below (e.g. kev, laya) and install it.
models.ollamaHint: Download a model (Ollama name or Hugging Face GGUF) or use one already on the server.
models.ollamaDown: Ollama is unreachable. Check the inference server URL in Settings.
models.identifierHintOnnx: Path of the .onnx file (relative to the models folder), e.g. models/laya-400m-v1.onnx
models.catalogHint: Pick the models to install for triage. Installation and progress are handled here. Stage 1 = fast pre-filter, stage 2 = extraction.
models.searchTitle: B. Generative model: search Hugging Face
models.searchHint: Search a GGUF model (e.g. “qwen3”), pick the quantization, install: Ollama downloads it.
models.noVariants: No installable variant in this repository.
models.pickQuant: Quantization (★ = recommended for CPU, sorted from best to least suited)
models.noTokenizer: This repository has no tokenizer.json: cannot install.
models.detected: Present on Ollama, not yet enabled
models.started: Download started: follow it at the top of the page.
models.errMlx: This Ollama model requires MLX (Apple Silicon): unavailable on this server. Pick a GGUF version in the search below.
models.decisionBody: BERT-like: reads a text and returns a calibrated score per question (yes/no, choice) in a single pass — very fast, no generation or quotes. Ideal to triage thousands of articles. Laya ships with the app.
models.generativeBody: LLM served by Ollama: reads the text, answers in JSON and quotes passages. Slower (~1-2 s/article), useful to extract details.
models.serverHint: For a model served over HTTP with the /v1/systemone protocol (Laya, Kev via llama.cpp…).
models.serverModelHint: E.g. multilingual or english for Laya.
models.noRecommended: No CPU-recommended variant in this repository: take the smallest (Q4 or Q5 if possible).
models.extHint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Mistral, your own vLLM…: give the API URL, key and model name. It quotes passages and explains its decision, usable at stage 1 or 2. Article text is sent to that service.
models.introUser: Your models and those shared with you. An external model you add can only be used by you unless you share it.
models.shareHint: The people and projects below can use this model (without seeing the API key). For a project: its leads.
models.decisionNotChat: This is a decision model (/v1/systemone protocol): it does not answer like a chat model and cannot be installed through Ollama. Serve it with llama.cpp (in the compose file: `COMPOSE_PROFILES=…,kev then docker compose up -d` for Kev, with KEV_URL=http://kev:8080) then register the server under “A. Add a decision server”.
models.svcHow: To enable it: COMPOSE_PROFILES={profile} (+ URL) in .env, then docker compose up -d.
models.svcExternal: External model — any OpenAI-compatible API (no local service required)

question.title: Question and answer fields
question.intro: Describe what you are looking for in the articles. Models answer this question for each article, with supporting quotes.
question.questionHint: E.g. Does the study specify the sex of the animals used?
question.fieldsHint: Each field is a piece of information to extract (yes/no, choice, text). They drive the gold, the scores and the annotation.
question.promptHint: Save, then generate the prompt: it is built automatically from the question and fields.
question.textHint: Parts of each article given to the models. Articles without full text are read on their abstract. Saved with the question.
question.depthHint: Decision models are slow on long texts (CPU). The text is read in slices of about 500 words; the best score is kept. Title + abstract alone is ~10× faster.
question.depthEstimate: For {n} articles: about {time} with the stage 2 model (Laya, CPU).
question.primaryHint: Used to rank the benchmark's models and prompts. Without one, the recall of relevance is used.

profile.title: My profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.languageHint: Applied to the interface and e-mails.
profile.dataHint: Download all your data, or request anonymisation of your account.
profile.anonymizeHint: Irreversible: your identity is erased; your annotations stay for research but are no longer linked to you.
profile.anonymizeConfirm: Permanently anonymise your account? You will be logged out.

team.title: Team
team.intro: Invite collaborators by e-mail: they receive a link to create their account and get direct access to this project.
team.roleHelp: Annotator: views results and reviews articles. Project lead: also imports, runs analyses and manages the team.
team.invitedSent: Invitation sent to {email}: a sign-up link valid for 7 days.
team.addedSent: {email} already has an account: added to the project, an e-mail lets them know.
team.invitedNoMail: The e-mail could not be sent (SMTP not configured in Settings). Give this link to {email}:
team.addedNoMail: {email} already has an account and was added to the project (e-mail not sent, SMTP not configured). Project link:
team.languageHelp: The chosen language is used for the invitation e-mail and the invitee's interface (they can change it later in the navigation bar).

adminUsers.title: Users
adminUsers.intro: Accounts, pending invitations and projects of the whole instance. Administrators only.
adminUsers.name: Name
adminUsers.deleteWarn: Permanently delete account {email}? Their external models, shares and settings are removed; their annotations are kept, anonymized.
adminUsers.deleteProjects: Also delete the {n} project(s) they created or solely lead (articles, PDFs, analyses, exports)
adminUsers.purgeConfirm: Delete every guest (non-creator) account that belongs to no project?
adminUsers.purgeHint: A guest account is deleted automatically when it loses its last project.
adminUsers.resentNoMail: E-mail not sent (SMTP not configured or down): pass this link on to {email}.
adminUsers.projectDeleteConfirm: Permanently delete project “{title}” and all its data?
adminUsers.creator: Creator
adminUsers.inviteNoMail: E-mail not sent to {email}: pass this link on.
adminUsers.inviteHint: A creator can create projects and invite people to them. Those guests cannot create projects and their account is deleted when they have no project left.

searches.title: Searches
searches.intro: A search asks a question (its answer items) to a batch of articles; its analyses, reviews and references belong to it. A search can be derived from the results of another one.
searches.deleteConfirm: Delete the search "{name}" with its results, reviews, analyses and references?
searches.stats: {lot, plural, one {# article} other {# articles}} · {predicted} analysed · {reviewed} reviewed
searches.leadOnly: Only a project lead can create searches.
searches.blindIntro: Review a random sample without seeing the AI's answer: this builds an unbiased gold standard before you run the full analysis. Creates a "blind" search with the same question as the current search, then opens the review.
searches.namePlaceholder: E.g. articles kept by the initial search
searches.selFromHint: The criteria below apply to the results of this search; with no criteria, its whole batch is reused.
searches.selSampleHint: Keeps N randomly drawn articles among those matching the criteria. The seed makes the draw reproducible.
searches.selected: {n, plural, one {# article selected} other {# articles selected}}
searches.questionHint: Copied from the original search; edit them if this search asks a different question.
